title: Private Access VM Password Requirements for STIG Compliance

blocks.text: For STIG compliance, your OS must enforce the following password rules for Private Access (ZPA) virtual machines (VMs):

blocks.item: Passwords must be a minimum of 15 characters in length.
When a password is changed, the new password must include:
A minimum change of 8 characters from the previous password.
A minimum change of 4 character classes (e.g., uppercase, lowercase, numbers, special characters).
Passwords must have the following character restrictions:
The number of repeating consecutive characters must not exceed 3 (e.g., aaa is restricted).
The number of repeating characters of the same character class must not exceed 4 (e.g., abcd is restricted).
These requirements are relevant for VM platforms (such as VMWare and Nutanix AHV) and hyperscalers (AWS, Azure, and GCP) when deploying Private Access components, including:

table: Passwords must contain at least 15 characters to ensure sufficient complexity.
Passwords must include characters from all 4 categories: Uppercase letters Lowercase letters Numbers Special characters
At least 8 characters must be different
The new password must differ from the previous password by at least 8 characters. This helps prevent reuse of similar passwords.
Old password: Secure@Pass31phrase New password: T3ch#Hardened98passLock
The same character cannot appear more than 3 times consecutively.
Maximum Consecutive Characters of Same Type (max class repeat)
No more than 4 characters from the same category (letters, numbers, or symbols) can appear consecutively.
